queries_run: Hyatt Hotels product substitute technology threat 2026
Lodging alternative technology disruption AI agents booking hotels 2026 2027

findings.claim: Hyatt 10-K 風險因子：生成式 AI 工具與 LLM（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等）決定提供何種資訊的方式，可能使 Hyatt 物業獲得的關注減少；資訊不準確也可能損及品牌聲譽。
findings.excerpt: The manner in which these AI tools decide what information to provide in response to a given user query may also result in our properties receiving less attention by users of these tools.

findings.claim: Hyatt 10-K：自家 AI 部分依賴第三方授權 AI 技術，無法控制其可得性與定價；若不相容或不可用，其方案吸引力下降。
findings.excerpt: We cannot control the availability or pricing of such third-party AI technologies, especially in a highly competitive environment, and we may be unable to negotiate favorable economic terms with the applicable providers.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅見 Hyatt 專屬替代技術威脅分析不存在；產業層面 AI 代理訂房（ZentrumHub 2026-06 報告估 2027 年底 5–8% OTA 訂房由 AI 代理完成）為廠商稿，未讀到逐字原文，列為 clue。

clues.claim: ZentrumHub 報告：預估到 2027 年底，OTA 訂房中 5–8% 可能由 AI 代理完成（廠商新聞稿，產業層面，非 Hyatt 專屬）。
